title: 'NHIS: Comparing Integrative Interventions for Pain Management'
author: "Tony Beal"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---
\
```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE,}
library(patchwork)
path <- getwd()
setwd(path)
source("utils.R")
load("adult_nhis_data.RData")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}
acu_pain_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(ACUPAIN != 0) |> 
  select(ACUPAIN) 

p_acupain <- ggplot(acu_pain_df, aes(factor(ACUPAIN, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#6BABD6", color = "#243845", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to ACUPAIN", 
    drop = FALSE, 
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 525), 
                     breaks = seq(from = 0, to = 550, by = 50)
                     ) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to ACUPAIN", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "During the past 12 months, \ndid you see a practitioner of acupuncture \nto treat or manage physical pain?"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15, unit = "pt")),
    plot.margin = margin(l = 25, unit = 'pt')
  )
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6, out.width="100%"}
mas_pain_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(MASPAIN != 0) |> 
  select(MASPAIN)

p_maspain <- ggplot(mas_pain_df, aes(factor(MASPAIN, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#97A6E6", color = "#370169", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to MASPAIN",
    drop = FALSE, 
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 2000)) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to MASPAIN", 
    y = "Count", 
    title = "In the past 12 months, \nhave you seen a practitioner of massage for pain?"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15, unit = "pt")), 
    #plot.margin = margin(l = 25, unit = 'pt')
  )

p_acupain + p_maspain
```
